description: arXiv:2609.06783v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: LLM agents operate in workflows where unsafe actions can have real consequences. Existing safety evaluations often reduce behavior to a single score, obscuring risk recognition, pre-action detection, and safe task completion when a safe solution exists. We introduce AURA-Eval, a framework combining controlled augmentation with granular diagnosis...
